items.text: Brian Burley is a trustee on the Huntington Beach City School District Board. He works as a system administrator at USC. He is also running for an at-large seat on the Huntington Beach City Council. A constitutional law expert told the Orange County Register that he likely could not serve in both offices if elected.

sentences.text: Brian Burley is a trustee on the Huntington Beach City School District Board.
He works as a system administrator at USC.
He is also running for an at-large seat on the Huntington Beach City Council.
A constitutional law expert told the Orange County Register that he likely could not serve in both offices if elected.

items.text: Burley said he would support responsible federal spending, tax relief for families and small businesses, expanded domestic energy production, and fewer costly federal regulations. To address housing affordability, he proposes expanding federal mortgage credit certificate programs for first-time homebuyers, with updated eligibility limits for high-cost areas. He says surveillance tools like license plate readers should be limited to targeted public-safety investigations, with warrants generally required and strict data retention limits. On immigration, he calls for permanently secured borders, completion of the border wall, nationwide employment verification, and stronger action against sanctuary jurisdictions.
